effects_provenance.raw: Sherbanger THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Sherbanger THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid bred from Sherbet crossed with Headbanger . The cross combines Sherbet's creamy dessert character with Headbanger's bold, gas-forward depth — producing a uniquely contrasting flavor profile and dense, well-structured buds with strong bag appeal. Effects Sherbanger delivers a versatile, well-balanced high suitable for various occasions. The cerebral side stays mood-lifting and conversational; the body baseline relaxes without becoming heavy — making this a flexible cultivar for daytime use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: creamy sherbet up front, with a sharp gas middle and a smooth, lightly fruit-leaning finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably contrasting. The terpene profile reads cream-and-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Sherbanger harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Sherbanger THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds.
